feature_weight_experiment.selection_rule: Choose the single-feature multiplier with the highest pooled winner-top3 rate across the two earlier chronological test folds; tie-break by winner-top1 rate. The latest one-year fold is excluded from selection.

holdout_comparison.note: Candidate remains research-only. Promotion requires repeatable improvement in ranking and trio ROI on independent future holdout data; this single selected holdout does not change live weights.

method.weight_policy: Ablations remove one learned B-model feature and renormalize. Challenger variants independently scale form, jockey, distance, or venue weight by a fixed multiplier and renormalize; they are selected only on the two earlier chronological test folds, then assessed on the untouched final-year holdout.
method.market_data: Official final confirmed odds are retrospective only and were not available before the race. This is a market benchmark, not a live pre-off comparison.
method.selection: All model and market picks are compared on the same holdout races with available official final odds.
method.production_impact: Diagnostic only. No live model weights, predictions, or G4 preregistered value thresholds are changed.
method.interpretation: Compare winner_top1_rate first. A feature whose removal improves the top-1 rate is a candidate for deeper review, not automatic deletion. Check sample size and uncertainty before any change.
